profile.headline: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer | Ruby, Rails, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, GraphQL | AWS | Docker & Kubernetes
profile.summary:
I am a Senior Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience in software development, including 8–10 years of hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails.

My primary focus is backend development using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, ActiveRecord, RESTful APIs, and GraphQL. I have experience developing and maintaining web applications, building backend services, integrating APIs, working with relational databases, and supporting enterprise application workflows.

Throughout my career, I have contributed to applications across healthcare, SaaS, enterprise software, employee onboarding, and banking domains. My experience includes backend development, database integration, application maintenance, debugging, code reviews, and end-to-end feature delivery.

Technical expertise includes:
• Backend: Ruby, Ruby on Rails, ActiveRecord, REST APIs, GraphQL
• Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB
• Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, HTML, CSS
• Cloud and DevOps: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, CI/CD

I also have experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot to support coding, debugging, refactoring, and code review workflows.

I value clean, maintainable code, practical problem-solving, and collaboration with engineering teams to deliver reliable software.

I am interested in opportunities focused on Ruby on Rails, backend engineering, and Rails-based full-stack development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working mainly on the backend side of the application using  Ruby on Rails to develop and maintain new and existing codebase.
Creating Docker images using Docker file and working on Docker container snapshots, removing images, and managing Docker volumes.
Deploying and maintaining sandbox and production environment using Capistrano with Docker.
Implementing the object-oriented principles for the great usability of the product.
Developing applications with Ruby on Rails MVC frameworks.
Developing applications using Ruby on Rails, backed by MySQL and Capistrano to automate and ease the deployment process on Phusion Passenger server.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Software Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developing and testing many features for dashboard using Ruby on Rails, Bootstrap, CSS JavaScript, and Rspec.
•	Creating and improving dynamic UI for a Ruby on Rails Single Page Application using JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX and Ruby.
•	Developing and maintenance of new and existing web application features for both internal administrators and end users using Ruby on Rails.
•	Involving in developing the Web Pages with best design and development procedures with security incorporated.
•	Designing and developing Spring boot adapter applications using rest API.
•	Implementing New Relic for getting application Insights.
•	Made a vast use of GIT for version controlling.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · REST APIs · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Agile Methodologies · HTML · React.js · Spring Boot

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
•Design and implement disaster recovery for the PostgreSQL Database.
•Designed the front-end application using Ruby on Rails 3.2, HTML, Handlebars, CSS, SASS, Java Script, AngularJS, and jQuery.
•Strong knowledge of Webpack and Angular CLI, and Microservices architecture using Spring Framework & 
  DB2.
•Worked with team of highly skilled engineers in the areas of IT system development, product selection, microservices infrastructure design to establish practices consistent with business strategy and priorities.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · REST APIs · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Agile Methodologies · HTML

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed features using Ruby on Rails in a UNIX/LINUX environment.
•	Developed front-end management features for the Ruby on Rails-based website. This involved view, controller, and model development as well as CSS and JavaScript front-end work too. SASS was used in later iterations.
•	Used Rspec to create test driven development. Experience with all of the GEMS and libraries for this version of the ruby.
•	Integrating client Direct Mobile Survey App with Heroku using RESTful API calls to add images to the user whenever new user created under Account.
•	Experience using Active Admin for maintaining admin section.
•	Used JavaScript for developing UI Components like Editable drop down, data-driven menu customizations.
•	Implemented Agile Work Environment while pair programming to complete the assigned tasks.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · REST APIs · Git · HTML

positions.locationName: Cranston, Rhode Island, United States · On-site

•	Work closely with Product Management, Marketing, and Development to maintain technical & functional knowledge of existing and new features.
•	Writing UI for exercise machine in Qt/QML/C++ on ubuntu
